note: Le garage (s02maison repaint 2026-10-22): single-storey garage workshop in the west wing (plan), camera facing west. Whitewashed brick, concrete floor, roof trusses; LANDMARKS tool pegboard over the workbench (zoom z1), green locker, plank store-room door with a big iron bolt. Back (west) wall: doorway with its white door swung open onto the sunny garden (-> R_garden, plan door x0 y4.5). The street garage door (south wall) is not in view; the PR19 breadcrumb leads back to the sector. Feminine left of x=700: woman holding a big slab of orange modelling clay with a key shape pressed into it against the locker padlock (clé; b15 fix: clay clearly visible), frog in swim goggles crouched on the plank on trestles as if on a diving board (planche), woman on the stepladder reaching a pink seashell (échelle), robot Ray fixing the bicycle (réparation). Masculine right: red little car (garage), carpenter holding up the tall stool he made (atelier), mole with a golf ball popping out of a hole (trou), workman sliding the iron bolt (verrou), father gluing a brick collage (bricolage). le outil moved to the workbench zone with the pegboard. Fix 0850: outpainted (all figures fully in frame), children removed from the plank/ladder.
